notes.title: Update 1.33 - Leaping Legends
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition! Update 1.33 has arrived, bringing new missions, fresh story content, and a brand-new breed to the ranch.[/p][p]
This update expands on cross country and steeplechase with new goals to chase and even more compelling story to unfold.  Whether you’re here for the story or simply to welcome a new horse to your ranch, there’s plenty to discover.
[/p][h2][b]New Horse Breed[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Introducing, for the very first time on the Rival Stars Ranch, The Anglo-Arab![/p][p]Originating in France, the Anglo-Arab blends the endurance and spirit of the Arabian with the speed and strength of the Thoroughbred. This balance makes it a natural all-rounder, well-suited for all types of events and rides, from flat racing to cross-country, show jumping and beyond.

 [b]Breed Bonus:[/b] 
+5 Agility 
+2 Sprint Energy [/p][p]
Alongside this new breed comes the Braided Mane, an elegant new trait you can add to your horses in the Horse Creator or pass down through breeding to create generations of gorgeous champions. This trait has a 40% chance of appearing on Anglo Arabs, and a 10% chance of appearing on any other horse.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/234c82a387d43ab2cffa00ddedae8dedcd392447.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]N[b]ew Story and Missions [/b][/h2][p]
Two storylines are expanding in this update, bringing new depth to both Cross Country and Steeplechase.

Cross Country continues with four additional chapters, featuring fresh missions and the return of Richard, whose presence adds new rivalries and opportunities to the competition.[/p][p]Steeplechase is getting its first set of story missions. The opening three chapters follow a journey shaped by family legacy and the arrival of Alex, a new character who sparks rivalries as the tournament approaches.

Together, these chapters introduce new challenges, new faces, and the next stage of your racing story.[/p][h2]
[b]New Coats: [/b][/h2][p]
Now, it's not a Rival Stars update without the addition of new coats to play around with! 

[b]Here’s what’s being added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sabino Wave[/p][/*][*][p]Inkblot Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Dusty Snowcap[/p][/*][*][p]Pearlescent Varnish[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Hind Fleabitten[/p][/*][*][p]Lavish Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Spiderweb Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Frosted Peacock[/p][/*][*][p]Polka Dot Rabicano[/p][/*][*][p]Roaning Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Beauty Mark Fleabitten[/p][/*][*][p]Roaning Rabicano[/p][/*][*][p]Saddled Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Stippled Tovero[/p][/*][*][p]Tobiano Jacket[/p][/*][*][p]Radiant Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Belly Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Rusty Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Starry Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Diamond Badger Face[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Anything Else? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Everyone deserves a makeover every now and again, and that's no different for the Rival Stars Menus and Game screens. As you're working your way through the game, keep an eye out for a refreshed look in the Training and Multiplayer screens
[/p][p]The Multiplayer hub has also been updated, you can now join other players’ games using a code. On top of that, we’ve added a handy change to the horse info screen: you can now train your horses directly from there.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/1ecce139a68583ae2773b94c31429a6d5121b931.png"][/img]
[/p][p]That's all for this update folks. Thanks so much for hanging out with us. We hope you enjoy your time with the new story content as well as the brand new Anglo-Arab. Don’t forget to join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/JC99MCGztx"]Discord [/url]to keep up with all things Rival Stars.[/p][h2]
Change Notes[/h2][p]
[b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Anglo Arab: New breed[/p][list][*][p]+5 Agility[/p][/*][*][p]+2 Stamina[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Steeplechase story mode: A completely new steeplechase story mode, ends at chapter 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Cross Country story mode update: New chapters for XC story, previously it ended on chapter 6, and now it ends on chapter 10. (4 new chapters)[/p][/*][*][p]20 New patterns +[/p][list][*][p]Sabino Wave[/p][/*][*][p]Inkblot Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Dusty Snowcap[/p][/*][*][p]Pearlescent Varnish[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Hind Fleabitten[/p][/*][*][p]Lavish Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Spiderweb Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Frosted Peacock[/p][/*][*][p]Polka Dot Rabicano[/p][/*][*][p]Roaning Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Beauty Mark Fleabitten[/p][/*][*][p]Roaning Rabicano[/p][/*][*][p]Saddled Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Stippled Tovero[/p][/*][*][p]Tobiano Jacket[/p][/*][*][p]Radiant Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Belly Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Rusty Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Starry Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Diamond Badger Face[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] New face [/p][list][*][p]Diamond Badger Face[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Trait: Noble Braid Mane: This trait has a 40% chance of appearing on Anglo Arabs, and a 10% chance of appearing on any other horse.[/p][/*][*][p]Training screen visual update, training is now also accessible from horse details.[/p][/*][*][p]The multiplayer screen hub has been updated, now you can enter other players' games by code.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller navigation on some screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Colour from breeding changed: now it’s much more probable to pass down to the foal the parents main and hidden colours[b].[/b][/p][/*][*][p]\[Bug fix] All Male Horse pedigrees now display correctly [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[Bug fix] Fixed navigation issues on Breeding, Steeplechase and some filters.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Players remaining in a multiplayer lobby might enter an NMA state when more than 3 users exit the room simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Flat racing multiplayer might not trigger the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Wide and Ultra wide screens are not yet supported[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Golden Shimmer - Update 1.32
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition! Update 1.32 – Golden Shimmer has arrived, and it’s a big one.
[b]
[/b][/h3][p]This update introduces a brand new breed, a stunning new environment, and a variety of quality-of-life improvements to keep things running smoothly. Whether you're here for the horses, the story, or the scenery, there’s something for everyone. It’s a packed update, so let’s jump into the full notes! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Akhal-Teke[/b][/h2][p]
Sleek, fast, and sure to turn heads, the Akhal-Teke has officially arrived on Desktop.[/p][p]With roots in the desert and a reputation for endurance, this breed is known for its athletic build and signature golden shimmer. Whether you’re racing or just showing off in the pasture, the Akhal-Teke brings both style and strength.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s not just a pretty face either. This debut comes with a powerful Breed Bonus:[/p][p]+5 Speed[/p][p]+2 Sprint Energy[/p][p]Get ready to add something truly special to your stables.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfHtrroep0EYfVDIj1LutSqg0QH94IvzBsIIKv8S_NzNj3IZPGslgoEp61ZX5g9aWyeR3b2iR3lfsuZ1O94ie4vlsK-3pwV7KXFTSHmpadL6vPXGFIMhMewgUyex5Duq4lJEO0JXg?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Traits![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Our last update introduced the first-ever trait to the desktop version: the Long Mane trait. In this update, we’re excited to introduce another trait, the Crystal Coat, which arrives with the Akhal-Teke.   Just like the Long Mane, the Crystal Coat is a visual trait that gives horses a sleek, glossy finish that helps them stand out. This trait can be acquired on any horse and can be stacked with the Long Mane Trait.[b]  [/b][/p][p]And thats not all, Traits can now be toggled on and off in the Horse Creator screen and are also now visible on the horse info screen 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGFtigvjuyPPWFvO5dpMZf5td4_urQc5hPyWHtROwKLg5BF-Nd9bq3nlzWeaqi6xkV-z-jOJW4Ja0Dw8FDnGSJV3bHP2ZtIQoSmkYTnwX3icPLlixtURQR-RHmTYHqqglPChoufg?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Golden Dunes  [/b][/h2][p]
Get ready to gallop to an epic new area. Welcome to the [b]Golden Dunes
[/b][/p][p]This beautiful desert landscape features winding village streets and distinctive clay buildings full of character. Soft golden sand dunes stretch out across the horizon, creating a warm and open setting. Along the paths, palm trees and desert greenery offer welcome shade as you ride. A peaceful oasis provides a quiet spot to pause and take in the view. It’s a sunlit, inviting place that’s perfect for relaxed rides and stunning photo opportunities.[/p][p]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe7Ihx5_a-JxvgGDtrP4RmfGuM4uYKo17jhBqVu1BTGJz0WbTLlzb6YIcAhFtsHs-3sYA65GLPj6Lu1AZpbuPuII1CZOaIhFMjcgYZT3L1cdZou1kqyIHST7u_uxCwvI08I4hy8RQ?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Ways To Capture[/b][/h2][p]
A brand new addition to photo mode has landed in Rival Stars Horse Racing Desktop Edition. 

We’ve added a feature that lets you advance time at a slower pace while in camera mode, making it easier than ever to capture that perfect mid-jump shot, your horse galloping through the Golden Dunes or a serene moment by the oasis.    [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFW71DxY2SCe5lE-kC9MWiIQHJf0F8nLsdujVCWXxCigyg_Dz8t4mxBNVlfmVedywkEOffRl-r5YnbYwlgIZcqriWfhZYDvGTS7vHwK8XGz2Iv8vdYoJZH3jOw_xBy-HURuU8DtQ?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"][/img][/p][h2]More Patterns![/h2][p][/p][p]The Akhal-Teke arrives with a whole new set of Patterns! You’ll find 20 brand new options to explore in the horse creator, so next time you’re customising, take a look, you might spot something new.
[/p][list][*][p]Majestic Snowcap[/p][/*][*][p]Swirled Snowcap[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Brindle[/p][/*][*][p]Tiger Brindle[/p][/*][*][p]Polka Dot Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Freckled Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Expressive Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Opaque Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard Frame[/p][/*][*][p]Sprinkle Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Neapolitan Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Odd Spot Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Lavish Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Frosted Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Splattered Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Fleabitten Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Lavish Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Swirled Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Lovely Sabino[/p][/*][/list][p]

That’s a wrap on Update 1.32, Thanks for hanging out!  With the Akhal-Teke now available in-game, a brand new environment to explore, some handy new tools in Photo Mode, and a bunch of new patterns, there’s plenty to check out. Whether you’re snapping screenshots, capturing video or just enjoying the ride, we’d love to see what you’re up to over in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/JC99MCGztx"]Discord[/url].

[/p][hr][/hr][p]

Change Notes
[/p][list][*][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Content] New breed, Akhal Teke[/p][list][*][p]+5 Speed[/p][/*][*][p]+2 Sprint Energy[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New unique horse trait: Shiny Coat - Crystal coat[/p][/*][*][p]New Location, Golden Dunes[/p][/*][*][p]\[Content] Cross Country Photo Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to skip tutorials on new saves[/p][/*][*][p]Filters for horse selection in breeding[/p][/*][*][p]Added a traits selector to the horse creator[/p][/*][*][p]Time speed slider for photo mode[/p][/*][*][p]20 New patterns:[b] [/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:

notes.title: New Breeds Just Landed - Update 1.31
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Welcome to the latest Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition update notes[/b][/h2][p]
In this update, we’re adding not just one but two new breeds! If you’ve been paying attention to our posts recently, you will have seen us teasing the Mustang breed, but if you looked a little closer, you might’ve spotted another familiar pattern starting to appear in the background. Yep, that’s the Appaloosa, and alongside the Mustang, they’re ready to join your stables.
[/p][p]It’s a packed update with plenty to explore. Alongside the new breeds, we’ve added new coats, a new dilution, and a handful of fun extras. - Let's jump into the update notes
[/p][h2]Welcome to the stable, Mustang and Appaloosa![/h2][h3]
[b]Mustang [/b][/h3][p]
The Mustang is built for adventure. With the stamina to roam and the speed to keep other horses on their toes, it's a great fit for all kinds of disciplines. And while it can dominate Flat Racing or charge through steeplechase, it's just as comfortable tackling the rugged trails of Canyon Falls. Whether you're out exploring or just soaking up the view, the Mustang brings bold energy wherever it goes.
[/p][p][b]Mustang Breed Bonus[/b][/p][list][*][p]+5 Sprint Energy[/p][/*][*][p]+2 Acceleration [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
Long Mane [/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b]We can't bring the Mustang to desktop without including its iconic Long Mane.

Mustang horses have a high chance of having a long mane, and this mane has a chance to be passed down to foals of all different breeds[/p][h3] 
[b]Appoloosa [/b][/h3][p]
Surprise! The Appaloosa is also joining the stables alongside the mustang  [/p][p]This striking breed is now available in Rival Stars Horse Racing. Known for its unique spotted coat and calm, friendly nature, the Appaloosa has earned a special place in the hearts of riders around the world. Known for their gentle temperament, Appaloosas are just as comfortable on the race track as they are in the show ring or on the trails.
[/p][p][b]Appoloosa Breed Bonus[/b] [/p][list][*][p]+5 Acceleration[/p][/*][*][p]+2 Jump
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d00635bc174440223b9bac5cb5e9379ade6aa39f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Patterns[/h2][p]
With the addition of two new breeds comes a bunch of new Patterns! Next time you're playing around in the horse creator, make sure you keep an eye out for these fresh new Patterns. There are 20 new patterns to play around with.   [/p][list][*][p]Spotted Tobiano[/p][/*][*][p]Patchwork Pinto[/p][/*][*][p]Splattered Overo[/p][/*][*][p]Scarred Roan[/p][/*][*][p]Masked Roan[/p][/*][*][p]Charred Roan[/p][/*][*][p]Sporadic Tovero[/p][/*][*][p]Horseshoe Sabino[/p][/*][*][p]Spiked Splash[/p][/*][*][p]Frosted Rabicano[/p][/*][*][p]Torn Dapples[/p][/*][*][p]Blended Lacing[/p][/*][*][p]Splash Cutout[/p][/*][*][p]Smudged Roan[/p][/*][*][p]Speckled Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Warped Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Majestic Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Sporadic Blanket[/p][/*][*][p]Few Spots Appaloosa[/p][/*][*][p]Masked Few Spots[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Dun Dilution
[/b][/h2][p]The Dun dilution is now available in the horse creator. This new Dilution adds more range to how your horses can look, with some subtle differences in tone and shading. We can’t wait to see the horses you create with it.
 [/p][h2]Anything else? [/h2][p]
We’ve added a couple of quality of life changes to improve your experience. First up, you can now rotate your horse in both the horse details menu and the horse creator. Whether you're checking out a new pattern, reviewing your customisation choices, or just admiring your horse, you can now see it from every angle.

There’s also a new settings button on the save file selection screen. This lets you adjust things like graphics, controls, or audio before loading into the game, so everything’s set up how you want it right from the start[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]

That’s everything for now! With both the Mustang and Appaloosa now available, there’s never been a better time to expand your stables and explore all the new patterns and dilutions. Whether you're mindlessly spinning your horse around in the creator or spotting fresh markings in the wild, we hope these additions bring some extra fun to your game.
[/p][p]Don't forget to join us on [url="https://discord.com/invite/JC99MCGztx"]Discord [/url]to stay up to date on all things Rival Stars, chat with other players, and share your latest creations. We’d love to see what you’re working on.[/p][p]
See you at the starting gate![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: A rugged new landscape - Update 1.30
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another round of update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!

notes.title: American Quarter Horses and Crossbreeding - Update 1.26
notes.notes:
Welcome to the latest update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!

Today's update introduces two exciting additions to the game, both set to change how you take the reins of Rival Stars Horse Racing. Let's jump straight in!

[b][h2]New Breed: American Quarter Horse[/h2][/b]

As promised in our last round of update notes, we are thrilled to introduce the Majestic American Quarter Horse to the stables!

A celebrated icon in the equine world with a rich history dating back to colonial America, the American Quarter Horse is renowned for its versatility and incredible speed over short distances. This breed has made a name for itself in racing, represented in game with a +5 Acceleration and +2 Speed bonus, the American Quarter Horse is primed to excel in races demanding quick bursts of power and speed.

[h3][b]How to get an American Quarter Horse:[/b][/h3]
You have a few options to get an American Quarter Horse in the game: the Horse Creator, Breeding Screen, and Market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/4b27e5c37b53e01e511bbc82c66297f628bde79f.png[/img]

[b][h2]New Feature: Crossbreeding[/h2][/b]

We have all these new horses, but what happens if you breed them together? Previously, breeding two different breeds of horses would result in a 50/50 chance of receiving a foal of either breed. Well, that has all changed with this update!

Introducing Crossbreeding: a game-changing feature that lets you create unique foals by combining different breeds. 

Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] [b]Crossbreed Definition: [/b] A horse with less than 90% of any particular breed is considered a Crossbreed.
[*] [b]Breeding Purebreds:[/b] Breed two different purebreds, and you’ll get a foal that’s a perfect 50-50 blend of its parents.
[/list]

Crossbreeds can have up to four breeds in their genetic makeup, offering exciting combinations to explore. Imagine breeding a horse with an Arabian’s sprint energy and a Thoroughbred’s increased speed. This results in a foal with a stunning and unique visual blend and bonuses to support your preferred playstyle.

The exact outcome of your foal’s breed makeup is shown in the ‘Definite Breed Makeup’ on the Breeding Screen, ensuring you always know what to expect. With so many visual blends to discover, the possibilities are endless!

Check out our updated Breeding Guide in-game for a deeper dive into Crossbreeding. Get ready to mix, match, and create a stable of one-of-a-kind champions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/2ea44511ba67091d416904fcd0c8f2914a4580d8.png[/img]

[h2]Cross Breed Bonuses[/h2]

When breeding crossbreeds, you'll notice a change in how bonus stats are distributed compared to purebreds. Instead of having one stat at +5, the bonus will be split across the two breeds. For example, a Thoroughbred with +5 Jump and an Arabian with +5 Sprint will produce a crossbreed with +3 Jump and +3 Sprint. Discover the best breeding strategy to create top champions

We can't wait to see the incredible horses you'll create as you explore these exciting new features. 

That wraps up this update, folks. Thanks for hanging out! Don't forget to stay tuned to the community for the latest news and competitions. Until next time, happy racing/riding, everyone!

[h1]Meet the new breeds[/h1]

[h2]Arabian[/h2]

Renowned for its beauty, intelligence, and endurance, the Arabian stands at 15.1 hands, boasting a distinctive face that adds to its majestic allure. Perfectly suited for any cross-country endeavour, this breed navigates diverse terrain easily and elegantly, reflecting centuries of selective breeding for agility and resilience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/fa331d369ebb6ed46112cb8b567f7cf8550480e3.png[/img]

[h2]Selle Français[/h2]

Originating from France, the Selle Français combines strength, athleticism, and a willingness to please its rider, making it the ultimate sport horse. Standing at 16 hands tall, these majestic creatures possess powerful hindquarters, enabling them to excel at jumping over obstacles with unparalleled prowess. With their blend of majesty and patience, Selle Français horses are esteemed champions in the field, making them an ideal choice for Steeplechase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/6fd1c48cdc6ec9ea820b4c74a77e43a556b469d2.png[/img]

These stunning new breeds are now available in-game, eagerly awaiting a new companion. They can be found within the Market, breeding screen Stud List, and the Horse Creator mode. 

With the introduction of these new breeds, we've implemented some adjustments to highlight the 
power and individuality of each horse. We refer to these as breed bonuses.

[h1]Breed Bonuses[/h1]

A breed bonus is the additional stats a horse receives at birth based on its breed. Keeping that in mind, let’s explore what makes each breed unique.

[h3]Arabian:[/h3] 
The Arabian's breed stat bonus of +5 to Sprint Energy and +2 to Agility makes it a formidable competitor in endurance challenges and Cross-Country events,

[h3]Selle Français:[/h3]
With a bonus breed stat of +5 in Jump and +2 in Acceleration, they excel in Steeplechase competitions, showcasing their agility and speed with finesse. 

[h3]Thoroughbred:[/h3]
With a bonus breed stat of +5 in Acceleration and +2 in Sprint, they shine in Flat Racing competitions, demonstrating their speed and mastery in dominating the track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/fbfae578bc9bd79fce019b3bd307150941a17af5.png[/img]


[h1]Cross breeding[/h1]

Currently, breeding between different horse breeds results in a 50/50 chance of obtaining either breed. Patterns, colours, and dilution may be inherited from both breeds, creating distinctive and unique combinations.

You can also pass on your legacy ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1166860/announcements/detail/7083669017351847897?snr=2___]see previous update notes[/url]) to a different breed allowing you to have a legacy of champion horses that span across disciplines.

That wraps up this update, folks. Thanks for hanging out! Don't forget to stay tuned to the [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/RivalStarsHorseRacing]community [/url]for the latest news and competitions. Until next time, happy racing/riding, everyone!

[h3][b]Welcome to the latest update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition.[/b][/h3]

This update takes us back to the roots, to the days when your grandfather managed the ranch with his loyal horse, Destiny’s Dream.


[h2]Let's get into it.[/h2]

Francis stumbled upon something we think will pique your interest.

Take the reins of your very own legacy horse, a descendant of your grandfather's horse. The legacy horse brings a whole new level of connection and bonding to your ranch, allowing you to pass down the legacy of your grandfather's horse through generations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/fea04bc8cab135d7e5a7ab6e5f38411b7c1c165c.png[/img]

[h2]What makes a legacy horse so special?[/h2]

Besides being a descendant of your grandfather's horse, legacy horses come with some pretty neat genetic advantages. Thanks to your special ties with the bloodline, the horse will now gain an extra experience boost.

[h2]How do I get a legacy horse?[/h2]

As we mentioned earlier, finding these incredible horses was all thanks to the wonderful Francis.  

Here he will inform you that he has found a bunch of Destiny’s Dream descendants, and its now your choice to pick which new equine friend you would like to bring home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/3e219bc24d504cde4d161e326a7c148ff37ceade.png[/img]

[h2]I have a legacy horse, what now?[/h2]

You can continue your lineage of legacy horses by continuing to breed using the initial legacy horse, with the end goal being to raise a champion horse from the same bloodline.

Your legacy will be able to be passed along to the offspring as long as the offspring's grade is equal or higher to the lowest grade parent.  To do so, head to the Manage Horse Screen of the Legacy horse and click Transfer Legacy, This will bring up a list of eligible legacy horses.

notes.title: Better Breeding - Update 1.21
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition![/b]

In this round of notes, we cover exciting changes made to Horse Stats and how they are passed down to foals, showcase some exciting new additions to the horse creator menu, as well as introduce and in game Breeding Guide.

Let’s jump into it.

[h2]Stats and Inheritance: [/h2]

Exciting News! Stat Grading is now available with the latest update, version 1.21! Horses are now assigned letter grades (ranging from D for ordinary to A+ for the pinnacle of perfection) to signify their excellence in each stat. You can view these from your usual stat screen. 

In 1.21, we've fine-tuned the process of foal stat inheritance, making it less random and increasing the likelihood of a foal having stats averaging those of its parents. - For instance, if the mare has “A+” Speed and the stud has “B” Speed, the foal is likely to have “A” Speed. However, if a foal is born at a higher grade than its parents, its stats won't be as high.

You can swap between letter and numbered stats on any screen stats are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/f70700413a5a62e84e635415b3d61dd7c872844a.png[/img]

[h2]Coat Colors and Dilutions[/h2]

Next time you're in Horse Creator mode, be sure to explore the latest additions in version 1.21, featuring the breathtaking Rich Brown and Flaxen Chestnut coat colors and dilution variants. Don't miss the opportunity to bring these stunning coat colors to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/7dc3fd7ff2899f92ea469a13f0e803d76e7b2c97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/96e9b216fbad52d018eb7e4a735284e39da2ef40.png[/img]
But that's not all! While you're checking out the brand-new variety of horse coats, you may notice a handy new addition to the feature. Coat color names and their dilutions are now viewable in Horse Creator mode!

[h2]Breeding Guide[/h2]

Curious about how breeding works? Look no further! The Breeding Guide now provides all the essential information for optimal breeding. You can access the breeding guide from the breeding screen, or on our website. We'll continue expanding the guide with future updates to breeding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/f0c26202afdd6427c7a25b8a316b703eb6ce1cfd.png[/img]

That’s all for this update folks. Thanks for hanging out, don’t forget to check out the [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/RivalStarsHorseRacing]community[/url] to keep up to date with recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone

Hey all, 

It's time for another update! In version 1.18 - Another Chapter, we're excited to introduce the first part of the Cross Country story mode, along with some fresh visual updates to the interface and more.

[h2]Cross Country Story is here![/h2]

The first part of the thrilling new Cross Country story is finally here! We've got three fresh chapters loaded with exciting new missions and a surprise addition to the squad - say hello to Kay Swiftwater!
This daring new character is joining the Rival Stars Horse Racing universe and is ready to help you become a champion on your Cross Country adventure. Get to know Kay and her unique skills as you gallop towards glory and compete against the top riders in the game. So, what are you waiting for? Saddle up and let's ride!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/c9707d30a777011c06243b01538056318d1cf2e7.png[/img]

[h2]Menu Screen [/h2]

Hooray for simplicity! We have made it easier for players to navigate through the game. The old mode selection screen is no longer in use, but fear not - it's been replaced by an even more efficient system. After selecting your save profile, you'll now be taken straight to the Story Home screen, allowing you to jump right into the action without any unnecessary steps. 

But what about the features on the main page, you ask? We've got you covered! 

[b]Horse Creator[/b] can now be found under the Stables menu so you can access it without leaving your game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/3558fa3d437729aaaa75db0e4db4dd7245717f8b.png[/img]

[b]Multiplayer, Quick race & Betting party[/b] are now accessible by going to the race menu and selecting “More Racing”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/6b39764aee5548621938e95834de6354beb336a7.png[/img]

[b]Game Settings [/b]is now under the Homestead screen. To [b]swap profiles[/b] just press back while on the Home screen.

[h2]Goals[/h2]

Alongside the main menus, the Goals tab has undergone a refresh to make it more user-friendly. The new polished screen combines the Daily, Racing, and Cross Country Goals, making it easier to keep track of your progress. Don't worry, your goals will still function in the same way - it's just a fresh new look! To access your Daily Goals, simply tap on the Daily button, and a menu will appear with all the daily goals and rewards waiting for you to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/54862d16c15ae8250291b5106813448d926d2341.png[/img]

[h2]Horse Creator - Quick buy[/h2]

The horse-buying process in the Horse Creator just got a whole lot easier! We heard your feedback loud and clear in the last user survey (you guys rock!), so we've simplified things to make your life simpler.
Gone are the days of creating a horse, saving it to your collection, opening your collection, pressing "Show in Story Market", going to Story, going to Market, refreshing the market, and finally, purchasing your new equine friend. Phew, even typing that out was exhausting!

Now, the new and improved flow is as easy as pie. Simply create your horse, and press the "Buy" button on the same screen. Yes, you read that right - just one screen! And the best part? You can even see in real-time how much your new horse will cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/e47e3c2eaf97895c8e5d145c2e073e7e814f6f6d.png[/img]

[h2]Added Button[/h2]

To improve screen navigation, a home button has been added to the user interface, allowing users to easily return to the home screen when needed.

[h2]Head Markings[/h2]

Last but not least, we've just added 25 new head markings to the game, and without being too biased, we think they look absolutely incredible! We can't wait to see what kind of beauties you'll breed!

notes.title: Picture this: Foals - Update 1.15
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi everyone, [/h1]

The latest Update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition is here!

This update is all about photo mode and the incredible editions that have been added, so let's get into it. 

Photo mode is now available in more places than before, including foal stalls, the pasture, and of course Free Roam. While you still have the ability to take stills using the provided backgrounds and poses, this takes in-game photography to a whole new level. 

[h2]Photo mode![/h2]

From the get-go, this new photo mode has a lot more features than the previous edition, these include, depth of field, lighting adjustments, filters, overlays, and appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/279bb03b09d5fa2b02a1216478fa9d7bdd7cdbfa.png[/img]

Once you have the desired shot lined up, you have the ability to hide the interface and snap the perfect shot using the f12 button. This will save your image to both your steam library and your default photo folder on your PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/26de92b005c9b94c8b2a38de15bec1d83ccea1a7.png[/img]

That's not all though. 

While in photo mode, using a combination of the mouse and “W, A, S, D” on the keyboard, or the thumbsticks on the controller, players have full control of the camera meaning they can capture images at all new angles and distances. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/84a485cb239ac47d203ef81da84d2421804886f9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/30f03eae2ec27b21f1fd2d67ddb1c1f8423d0278.png[/img]

[h2]Accessing Photo mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/3b393f967452b2cac9b3483d18fb1f2023a4f1ee.png[/img]

To access photo mode in the Pasture and Foaling Stalls, head to the desired feature you wish to take photos from and hit the “Photo Mode” button. 

Accessing Free Roam’s photo mode is a little different from the Pasture and Faoling stalls, once you are ready to take the photo hit the “Q” key to bring up the Photo Mode menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d276e01270facb116ab16cedf0cc70391f1d8077.png[/img]

We are excited to see the exciting and wonderful moments you capture with the new and improved photo mode. 


Don’t forget to check out the community to keep up to date with recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone.

notes.title: Rankings, Runnings & Results - Update 1.14.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

We are back with another exciting update for you all!

You have been honing your Cross Country skills for a few weeks and now it's time to put it to the ultimate test with the introduction of  Cross Country Leaderboards!

For those who have played the mobile edition of Rival Stars Horse Racing, this will work differently from the leaderboards and Live events you have all grown to know and love

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/bcc6d0340f46b3b1e375e7b681c74d64ea557e7e.png[/img]

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]

Leaderboards work in seasons with each season lasting for 2 weeks. New seasons kick off on Thursdays at 12:00 PM EST, giving every player the chance to prepare and train their horses to become Cross Country Champions.

Each Cross Country Course has its own Leaderboard, with Pro mode being integrated into its respective related course. To get to the top of the leaderboard, players need to not only beat the optimal time set for the course but also make sure they are completing the course faster than others. Scores/Times are connected to your steam ID, meaning you can only register one time for each course.

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]

There are a few different ways to interact with the leaderboard. 

The leaderboard will show the “world” leaderboard by default.

Selecting the friend button next to the leaderboard will shift the leaderboard view from the world leaderboards to a friends-only view showing you how you are doing in the current season vs your friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/11c6e0147fcd697c12660e5914e115b712263ebd.png[/img]

To view the leaderboard for the current season or take a look at the past season's winners you’ll want to click the “Trophy” Icon at the top of the leaderboard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/b4e5fcc1083ed71f69e2ac549dbae34d489358aa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/4d7ab4b732cde55fd809093b09525d7d05614861.png[/img]

In the meantime, players will be competing for bragging rights. However, we are collecting feedback and will be evaluating the best way to reward the season winners

We can't wait to see everyone compete and start climbing the leaderboard!

Don’t forget to check out the community to keep up to date with the recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone.


[h3]Summary [/h3]

[list]
[*] New Leaderboards added to all six Cross Country tracks!
[*] New Leaderboard seasons system
[*] New Season Champions screen
[/list]

notes.title: Cross Country - Update 1.14
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Cross Country [/h1]

We are proud to announce the latest game mode in  Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition — Cross Country! 

That’s right! You've been training your Jump and Agility stats for a few months now and it's finally time to put them to use!

[h2]Let's get into it![/h2]

What is Cross Country? 

You've already had a small taste of Cross Country with the addition of jumps in the free roam area, but now it's time for a true challenge. Cross Country is the ultimate test for your horse’s speed, endurance, and jumping skills. Scoring is kept true to real life, which means to land the medal you are after, you have to navigate your way through the tracks, execute those perfect jumps, and complete the track as close to the set time as possible!

Nail all these elements and you’ll be well on your way to being a Cross Country champion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d36365cd4091dea2a8873de3d126021dadc6575d.png[/img]

Accessing Cross Country can be done in the Race and Ride menu once you have reached Prestige 4. From there, you need to select your course and the horse you wish to compete with. 
By completing each event within a certain time frame, you will begin to unlock new tracks. Every track has eligibility criteria that are dictated by the horse's level, meaning the higher you train your horse the more tracks it can compete on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/b48db262f831707d6701f053bfb0b6ce7b455c4d.png[/img]

[h2]Pro difficulty[/h2]

Pro is a second difficulty level for those who really want to challenge their Cross Country abilities. 

You can access Pro difficulty by changing the difficulty toggle on the Cross Country course select screen, but it will only become available once you have unlocked and completed all the tracks on Normal difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d0ed2ed65dbeb11af164bedb1f336e559a3214b9.png[/img]

We are continuing to expand and develop Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition and today we are excited to share a sneak peek at some of the updates we have coming soon.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/6f60e1b006579d97d9e8c5951e201637660fbc7d.png[/img]

These updates are scheduled to be available very soon, with version 1.14.1 arriving in a few week’s time and 1.15 releasing in late October/early November.

Don’t forget to check out the [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/RivalStarsHorseRacing]community[/url] to keep up to date with the recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone.

notes.title: Green Pasture - Update 1.13
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition, Greener Pastures Update!

[h1]
Welcome to your brand new Pasture! 
[/h1]

The Pasture is a brand new beautiful plot of land you have recently acquired allowing you to transport and store your horses. You can move your horses from your stables and into the Pasture for retirement reasons, or maybe you just need to free up space in your stalls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d65ae367a99f82246c62fa8e704117f9747c8d8f.gif[/img]

The Pasture is not just a storage box for your horses! Starting from Prestige 6, you can move your horses to and from the pasture! This can be done by clicking on the Pasture button in your stables, here you have the opportunity to view your horses interacting with each other and enjoying their time rolling in the grass, but that's not all, the Pasture allows you to have full camera control to get the best angles on your horses.

It is important to remember that If your horse is placed in the pasture you will not be able to race, train or breed with it until you return the horse to your stables, However, you are still able to take your horse out on a Free Roam adventure!

[h1]How do I place a horse in the Pasture?[/h1]

Moving your horses to and from the Pasture is simple! Start by selecting the horse you wish to move from your stable and click the “manage horse button” on the top right of your screen (this appears as a horse/gear icon) From here you will see the option to  “Move To Pasture” button, clicking this will successfully move your selected horse to the Pasture. 

Bringing a horse back from the Pasture is much the same. First head to the Pasture from the stables, Select the horse you wish to return, select “Manage Horse” and confirm the transfer back to the stable by selecting “Move To Stables”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/0899a550679ff05a766d63c665050c6b363cd053.png[/img]

[h1]How many horses can I have?[/h1]

No longer do you need to consider how many stalls you have available when breeding or purchasing a new horse because your Pasture space is able to hold up to a massive 60 horses at one time.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/121f3c077c42bfefb1f076f918c3e18c72421821.png[/img]

[h1]Looking to the Future[/h1]

We have some exciting features making their way to the Desktop Edition later in quarter 3 that we can’t wait to share with you. Shortly we will release a Roadmap covering the remainder of the updates for 2022.

We are constantly working to improve and expand the world of Rival Stars Horse Racing, so please keep leaving your feedback so we can continue to build on and help make Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition the best Horse Racing Game, not just on Steam but in the world!


[b]Change List[/b]

[list]
[*] Players can send horses to pastures starting at prestige level 6
[*] All 60 pasture slots are unlocked by default!
[*] New horse manage popup allows users to easily transfer, sell and rename horses from the same screen
[/list]

Hello from the Rival Stars Horse Racing Desktop Edition team!

Welcome to the 1.12.1 Update notes. In this round of notes, we will be covering, Stat Training, Photo mode, and the highly requested feature….

[h2]Max Betting[/h2]

We have seen a high number of requests to add a Max betting button to the game, and we are excited to announce that it has finally made its way to the Desktop edition. No longer will you have to scroll to reach the maximum betting amount, now you have the option to set the maximum bet amount at the click of a button. Like always, this can be found on the Betting Party screen, Quick Ride mode, and Story Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/91da6f42f17e023daf805dbbd69bea7f87996540.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/e08ed023bae82b339c9a60cbc6760cd2edb33db9.png[/img]

[h2]Training Stats[/h2]

Now that Jump has made its way to Desktop Edition, we can get into the nitty-gritty of enhancing your riding experience. 

Making those tight turns in free roam is inevitable but the Agility stat is here to help. Training the Agility stat will allow your horse to make those tighter turns without having to compromise speed.  

The Jump stat is the key to regaining your sprint energy. Nailing a Jump successfully instantly regains a portion of your horse's Sprint Energy. The higher you train the stat the more sprint energy you will recover, preparing your horse for the next jump.

To train the Agility and Jump stat you will need Agility/Jump Feed, this can be purchased in the Marketplace or gained from successfully completing story races 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/31aa6d512aa61c78eed07934a4370ddf70f8468b.png[/img]

[h2]Photo mode[/h2]

Since the launch of the title, we have loved seeing the creative and amazing screenshots of your horses enjoying their time in the Free Roam environments, and in this update, we have made this easier for you!

Introducing the Free Roam Camera! A single button click will hide any on-screen text and allow you to capture those incredibly special moments between the rider and horse.

Once Photo mode is active all you need to do is take a screen capture and you are set! The Free Roam Camera is available in both Free Roam locations, we can’t wait to see the stunning photos you take! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/2f505ad6bf1dfb38dcd1a8409b00bfa9b9dafc28.png[/img]

[h2]Looking to the future[/h2]

Our next update is called “Green Pastures” and while we can’t give away too much at this stage we hope the name provides a hint at what's to come. 

We want to thank you for the support as we continue to develop and support Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition, and hope you’re excited to try out the new features! Have fun and we’ll see you next time!

~The Rival Stars Team.
